title: LeMans Karting
specs: Virginia's largest and fastest indoor go kart track
Zero Latency VR arena with free roam and multiple games
Must have Annual License per driver ($10, lasts 365 days)
Minimum age to race is 8 years old and at least 48" tall
Kids as young as 5 years old and 40 lbs can ride as passenger with adult
Youth drivers 11-17 without license must take Jr Driver's Class to qualify for faster karts
Minimum age for Zero Latency VR is 12 years old
Must wear closed-toed shoes, secure loose clothing and hair, bring driver's license or learner's permit
Birthday parties with private rooms available

blurb: Guests race high-speed gas karts on Virginia's largest indoor track with options for different kart types and leagues. The facility also offers a Zero Latency VR arena, laser tag, axe throwing, and arcade games. They host birthday parties, group events, and corporate team building with catering and private rooms.
extraNote: Race or VR credit valid for 6 months from purchase date, non-refundable · Emergency rescheduling possible by calling · Late arrivals forfeit reservation and may face longer wait times
